known_limitations: The package version remains 0.2.0-dev until an approved public release decision.
The hosted Sites URL is owner-only and has not been made public or attached to ftfn.io.
Twenty-five signals, two briefings, three dependency maps, and local-system constraint profiles remain non-published or prelaunch material.

The 2026 National Defense Strategy is represented in the downloadable collection by an official-link file because the Defense Department host allowed review but suppressed automated export; the other 22 records have local captures.
The public JSON files are static build exports, not a live API or database-backed service.
The 150-record candidate registry is an ignored local file and requires private backup outside public Git.
The optional bulk candidate-link audit was blocked by uniform outbound Node network failures in the verification environment; every candidate still requires live human confirmation before promotion.

The Project Baccara record now includes an official 4-1 County action and final active air permit, but it does not prove the fully executed MCP, condition compliance, service, construction, occupancy, or operation.

The Toronto application 24 254930 record is scheduled for City Council on July 29-31, 2026; no Council disposition, enacted by-law, permit, start, completion, or occupancy is claimed before that meeting.
Supabase activation, automated monitoring, analytics, accounts, and public alerting are separate later decisions.
notes: This manifest records the locally verified and owner-only deployed Phase 55K DARPA and U.S. Government research collection. The collection contains 23 reviewed document summaries, 22 official local captures, one official-link record, 23 Tier 1 source profiles, five In Review synthesis signals, one In Review briefing, and one In Review dependency map. Sites version 9 serves source commit 37f3ca6956d752642989f04486d13ff0c4555813. Access remains custom with one allowed owner and no groups. The ftfn.io and www.ftfn.io custom-domain entries remain pending DNS validation and do not route to the Site. This manifest does not authorize public access, DNS changes, public GitHub synchronization, or package freeze.
